Confirmed — both test files genuinely invoke `assertCan`, while `issue-repository.test.ts` only spies on it to assert it's *not* called (no real invocation), and the manifest scripts/comments only reference the name as a string or in prose.

The throwing authorization guard is `assertCan` (`src/lib/permissions.ts`), which throws `PermissionDeniedError`, distinct from the boolean-returning `can`/`explain`/`canAll`. Every file that actually calls it:

ANSWER: src/server/services/search-service.ts, src/server/services/activity-service.ts, src/server/services/billing-service.ts, src/server/services/issue-service.ts, src/server/services/project-service.ts, src/server/services/label-service.ts, src/server/services/feature-flag-service.ts, src/server/services/webhook-service.ts, src/server/services/member-service.ts, src/server/services/invitation-service.ts, src/server/services/notification-service.ts, src/server/services/attachment-service.ts, src/server/services/organization-service.ts, src/server/services/comment-service.ts, tests/contract/permissions.test.ts, tests/lib/permissions.ownership.test.ts
